The gaoler would not open the door; he says Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key, which fits her dismissing the fort. 2. Return to the hunt: go to Bell Station by boat from Lilmoth and ask the divers which drowned tower is marked. 3. Go to Bell Station first, or return to Helstrom and confront Never-Writes-Twice about the key and the cellar. 4. I do not know who is held in the cellar or why the order hides them; I could not learn it here.

answer Notes: Cellar Door quest done. I entered Fort Chalkmoth unseen via the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom, without fighting the Sarpa raiders; the captain Sakeeus-Wan had offered 100 gold for killing three, which I did not take. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku guards the locked inner cellar door (needs a key, cannot be picked); he says Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key, and that those below sleep and dream. Something moans behind the door. The quartermaster store has Hist Sap jars tied with the Jal-Veesa knot; I took one. Who is held down there and why is unknown, and Never-Writes-Twice looks suspicious. I still carry the Unbound recipe, Keystone, Paralysis-Poison x3, 2 lockpicks, a rapier and about 1050 gold. Next: Bell Station (boat from Lilmoth) to find the marked drowned tower; Vanin is digging ahead of us.
